description: This Swift source file defines the PresenceReporter class, responsible for periodically reporting system presence information such as IP address, host name, app version, and input activity. It manages background tasks for sending system events to a control channel and provides utility functions for composing presence summaries and retrieving system info.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: A singleton class that handles periodic and immediate presence reporting, including gathering system info, composing messages, and sending events to a control channel.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates a background task that periodically reports the system's presence every few minutes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing presence reporting task.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Assembles system info and sends a presence event to the control channel with the given reason.

methods.name: sendImmediate
methods.description: Triggers an immediate presence report without waiting for the periodic interval.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Generates a textual summary of the current system state for presence reporting.

methods.name: appVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the application's version string, combining the short version and build number.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the current operating system version.
